<style>
  main.content {
    overflow-x: clip;
  }
  .t-editor .editor-content,
  .t-editor {
    padding-bottom: 0;
  }
  .t-editor .editor-static .page-node,
  .t-editor .page-node,
  .t-editor .content {
    padding-bottom: 0;
    margin-bottom: 0;
    /* the hero starts right under the header, as the home page's does */
    margin-top: 0;
  }
  /* ------------------------------------------------------------------
     The hero, after the home page's: the copy centred on the first
     screen, the spacing between the heading, the lede and the buttons
     the same (12px, then 24px), and the buttons as pills, the second of
     them the one that puts the Scalar setup prompt on the clipboard.

     Under it, every customer on this page as a ball of its own, the
     mark and the name round its equator like the planets on the home
     page. They drop in from over the fold and settle in a row on a
     hairline floor, which is the hero's bottom edge; landing.js
     (initCustomerBalls) runs the world and lets a pointer throw them.
     ------------------------------------------------------------------ */
  .cust-hero {
    /* the floor and its balls reach past the text column, up to 160px
       each side, as far as the room beside the content allows; the copy
       stays its own width, centred over them */
    --cust-bleed: max(0px, min(160px, (100dvw - var(--scalar-sidebar-width, 0px) - 100%) / 2 - 24px));
    position: relative;
    width: calc(100% + 2 * var(--cust-bleed));
    margin-inline: calc(-1 * var(--cust-bleed));
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    /* a screen, never more than 640px, so the row of balls along the
       bottom edge is there before any scroll; the room under the copy
       is the balls' */
    min-height: min(calc(90dvh - var(--scalar-header-height, 48px)), 640px);
    /* The home page leaves 24px under its hero copy and 104px more for
       the logo strip; the balls take that room here. The 21px on top of
       that is the third line of lede this page's shorter subhead does
       not use, and it is what puts this heading on the same line as the
       home page's rather than half a line lower. */
    padding: 48px 0 149px;
  }
  .cust-copy {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    width: 100%;
    /* the home page's hero copy: 680 wide, centred in the room above
       the balls, its lines balanced */
    max-width: 680px;
    margin: auto 0;
    min-width: 0;
    text-wrap: balance;
  }
  .cust-hero .hero {
    align-items: center;
    text-align: center;
  }
  .cust-copy .t-editor__heading {
    --font-size: var(--scalar-heading-1);
    margin-top: 0;
  }
  /* the heading is a flex row (it holds its anchor button) */
  .cust-hero .hero .t-editor__heading {
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .cust-hero .hero > .flex {
    justify-content: center;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-lede {
    /* a narrow measure: three lines under the heading */
    max-width: 460px;
    margin: 0;
    /* 14px, a step under the body size */
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 1.5;
    color: var(--scalar-color-1);
    text-wrap: pretty;
  }
  /* the calls to action as pills: the theme's button rounded full, and
     beside it "Onboard your agent", three agents in a stack, the label
     and a copy mark. A click puts the setup prompt on the clipboard
     (landing.js keeps its words); the mark turns into a check and the
     label says to paste, for a moment. The label keeps the width of its
     wider wording so the pill never jumps */
  .cust-hero .lp-hero-cta {
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    /* 12px on top of the hero's 12px gap: the pills sit 24px under the
       subhead, a little apart from the copy */
    margin-top: 12px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  /* no margin: the theme's button carries one, which drops it below the
     other pill */
  .cust-hero .lp-hero-cta .lp-pill {
    min-width: 0;
    height: 40px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0 20px;
    border-radius: 999px;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-hero-cta .lp-onboard {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 0 12px 0 8px;
    border: var(--scalar-border-width) solid var(--scalar-border-color);
    background: var(--scalar-background-1);
    color: var(--scalar-color-1);
    font-family: var(--scalar-font);
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
      background 150ms ease-in-out,
      border-color 150ms ease-in-out;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-hero-cta .lp-onboard:hover {
    background: var(--scalar-background-2);
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-hero-cta .lp-onboard:focus-visible {
    outline: 1px solid var(--scalar-color-1);
    outline-offset: 2px;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-agents {
    display: flex;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-agent {
    display: grid;
    place-items: center;
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--scalar-background-1);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--scalar-border-width) var(--scalar-border-color);
    color: var(--scalar-color-1);
    transition:
      background 200ms,
      box-shadow 200ms;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-agent + .lp-onboard-agent {
    margin-left: -8px;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard:hover .lp-onboard-agent {
    background: var(--scalar-background-2);
    box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--scalar-border-width)
      color-mix(in srgb, var(--scalar-border-color), var(--scalar-color-1) 15%);
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-agent svg {
    width: 14px;
    height: 14px;
  }
  /* the marks in the text colour, their own colours and gradients set aside */
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-agent svg [fill] {
    fill: currentColor;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-text {
    display: grid;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-text > span {
    grid-area: 1 / 1;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-done,
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard.is-copied .lp-onboard-rest {
    visibility: hidden;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard.is-copied .lp-onboard-done {
    visibility: visible;
    animation: cust-onboard-in 220ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  }
  @keyframes cust-onboard-in {
    from {
      opacity: 0;
      translate: 0 4px;
    }
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-icon {
    position: relative;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    margin-left: 2px;
    color: var(--scalar-color-3);
  }
  /* the build inlines each scalar-icon as an svg carrying its class, so
     the two marks are styled as svgs, stacked in the one box */
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-icon svg {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    display: block;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    transition:
      opacity 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1),
      scale 200ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard-check,
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard.is-copied .lp-onboard-copy {
    opacity: 0;
    scale: 0.5;
  }
  .cust-hero .lp-onboard.is-copied .lp-onboard-check {
    opacity: 1;
    scale: 1;
  }

  /* The field the balls live in: the hero's own box, clipped, so a ball
     waiting over the fold or thrown at an edge never widens the page.
     It is behind the copy, and only the balls themselves meet a
     pointer */
  .cust-field {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    overflow: clip;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  /* the floor: the hairline the balls settle on, drawn like every other
     border on the page */
  .cust-floor {
    position: absolute;
    right: 0;
    bottom: 0;
    left: 0;
    height: 0;
    border-bottom: var(--scalar-border-width) solid var(--scalar-border-color);
  }
  /* A ball sits at the field's origin and the script moves it with
     translate, on a layer of its own, so a frame of the fall is
     compositing work and never layout */
  .cust-ball {
    --ink: #fff;
    --tint: #f8f8f8;
    position: absolute;
    /* the room the ball's surface turns in: seven times the ball across,
       deep enough that a piece near the front is not blown up past the
       ball's own edge */
    perspective: calc(var(--s) * 7);
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    width: var(--s);
    height: var(--s);
    pointer-events: auto;
    cursor: grab;
    /* a finger dragged sideways takes the ball with it, while one
       dragged up or down scrolls the page as it would anywhere else */
    touch-action: pan-y;
    user-select: none;
    will-change: translate;
  }
  .cust-ball.is-held {
    z-index: 3;
    cursor: grabbing;
  }
  /* The ball is painted in three layers, in this order: its colour,
     then the mark, then the light. The light and the shading lie over
     the mark, so the mark is printed on the ball and takes the dark
     crescent along the top and the sheen along the bottom with
     everything else, rather than being stuck to the front of it. The
     light is the room's, so it stays where it is however the ball
     rolls, and only the mark between the layers turns. */
  .cust-ball-paint {
    --lp-ball-light: radial-gradient(
      calc(var(--s) * 0.7) calc(var(--s) * 0.6) at 50% calc(50% + var(--s) * 0.54),
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.45),
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 70%
    );
    --lp-ball-paint: radial-gradient(
      calc(var(--s) / 2) at 50% 50%,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--tint) 90%, white) 40%,
      var(--tint) 80%,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--tint) 88%, black) 100%
    );
    --lp-ball-shade:
      inset 4px 16px 18px -12px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45),
      inset 0 -5px 8px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.35);
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--lp-ball-paint);
    /* the ball's own box is what the pointer meets */
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .cust-ball-gloss {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--lp-ball-light);
    box-shadow: var(--lp-ball-shade);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  /* a dark ball: the body lifted off black, the rim catching light at
     the top instead of shading */
  .cust-ball--dark .cust-ball-paint,
  .cust-ball--dark .cust-ball-gloss {
    --lp-ball-light: radial-gradient(
      calc(var(--s) * 0.7) calc(var(--s) * 0.6) at 50% calc(50% + var(--s) * 0.54),
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.22),
      rgba(255, 255, 255, 0) 70%
    );
    --lp-ball-paint: radial-gradient(
      calc(var(--s) / 2) at 50% 50%,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--tint) 55%, #8b8b93) 52%,
      color-mix(in oklab, var(--tint) 80%, #4a4a52) 86%,
      var(--tint) 100%
    );
    --lp-ball-shade:
      inset 4px 16px 18px -12px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35),
      inset 0 -5px 8px -5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5),
      inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.12);
  }
  /* The mark, lying on the ball's surface rather than stuck to its
     face. landing.js cuts it into a grid of little pieces and places
     each one with its corners on the sphere, so the mark narrows
     towards the rim and goes over the horizon as the ball turns, and
     nothing it does can carry it past the ball's own edge.

     The cage turns about the ball's axle, which is square to the way
     the ball travels. We are looking down at the floor rather than
     along it, so that axle leans well out of the screen, and it is
     that lean which carries the mark over the horizon and round the
     back instead of spinning it where it lies: an axle along the line
     of sight would only ever turn the face of the ball on the spot,
     which is a sticker, not a ball. */
  .cust-ball-roll {
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    transform-style: preserve-3d;
    transform: rotate3d(0, 0.8480, -0.5299, var(--roll, 0deg));
    pointer-events: none;
    will-change: transform;
  }
  .cust-quad {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    display: block;
    /* the matrix places the piece outright, from its own corner */
    transform-origin: 0 0;
    /* the far side of the ball never shows through the near side */
    backface-visibility: hidden;
    background-repeat: no-repeat;
  }
  /* Each ball in its brand's colour, at a size of its own, in the range
     the home page gives its planets (92 to 116). landing.js scales the
     heap from these as the column narrows, writing the size it lands on
     back onto each ball. */
  .cust-ball--bobcat {
    --s: 104px;
    --tint: #ff3600;
  }
  .cust-ball--warp {
    --s: 112px;
    --tint: #000000;
  }
  .cust-ball--clerk {
    --s: 96px;
    --tint: #6c47ff;
  }
  .cust-ball--zoom {
    --s: 100px;

  }
  .cust-ball--lufthansa {
    --s: 108px;
    --tint: #05164d;
  }
  .cust-ball--thomson-reuters {
    --s: 116px;
    --tint: #d64000;
  }
  .cust-ball--tailscale {
    --s: 94px;
    --tint: #1f1e1e;
  }
  .cust-ball--later {
    --s: 102px;

  }
  .cust-ball--dedalus {
    --s: 98px;

  }
